name: path
label: Path
help: The folder where uploads land. Leave it empty for the root of the bucket.

name: password
label: Password
help: Senders need this password to upload.

name: maxFileSize
label: Maximum file size (bytes)
help: The largest file a sender can upload, in bytes.

name: allowedFileTypes
label: Allowed file extensions
help: The file extensions senders can upload, for example `pdf`. Leave it empty to accept every type.

name: maxUploads
label: Maximum uploads
help: The file request stops taking files after this many uploads.

name: visitorIdentity
label: Ask senders who they are
help: Ask senders for their name and email.
